text:
🗳️ OFFICIAL: the IEC has declared the 2026 local government elections free and fair.

National results (2021 in brackets):
🔹 ANC 30.76% (45.59%)
🔹 DA 24.64% (21.66%)
🔹 MK 9.76% (new)
🔹 EFF 6.22% (10.31%)
🔹 ActionSA 5.67% (2.33%)

Turnout was 52%, about 14.9 million voters, up from 45.9% in 2021.

🏛️ Councils: only 74 of 213 councils have a party with an outright majority. 137 are hung and will need coalitions.

🏙️ The metros:
✅ Cape Town: DA 56.42%, the only metro with a majority
Johannesburg: DA 34.79%, ANC 20.25%, ActionSA 16.27%
Tshwane: DA 34.37%, ActionSA 22.07%, ANC 20.22%
Ekurhuleni: DA 30.68%, ANC 22.11%, ActionSA 18.50%
eThekwini: MK 38.29%, DA 25.45%, ANC 16.43%
Nelson Mandela Bay: DA 44.17%, ANC 25.48%
Buffalo City: ANC 41.93%, UDM 18.39%, DA 16.85%
Mangaung: ANC 33.91%, DA 33.49%

What it means for your pocket: the coalition deals made in the next few weeks decide who becomes mayor, and who sets your property rates, water and electricity tariffs for the next five years.

Which coalition would you trust with your city's budget? 👇

sources: IEC declaration 8 Nov 2026 (Midrand): free and fair, 212/213 councils final, Douglas re-vote, turnout ~14.9m/29.2m = 52% (2021 45.9%), national shares ANC 30.76 DA 24.64 MK 9.76 EFF 6.22 ActionSA 5.67, 74 majority / 137 hung, outright control ANC 53, DA 12, IFP 5, MK 3: IOL 8 Nov 'IEC declares elections free and fair, orders fresh vote in Douglas'. National shares with 2021 comparisons (ANC 45.59, DA 21.66, EFF 10.31, ActionSA 2.33): BusinessTech 'Final 2026 election results announced'. Metro vote shares and majority status: The Citizen 'final 2026 LGE results for SA's eight metros' + BusinessTech. Buffalo City 'no majority' inferred from 41.93% vote share; Mangaung seats ANC 35 DA 34 of 101 (esp.info 19:02). Note: 74+137=211; 212 councils final, 1 pending (Siyancuma).
